fact: A mid-term evaluation of the SNDS 2023-2025 found an overall implementation rate of 32.09 percent across 592 planned activities, with recommendations for the central body and sector administrations.
title: Rapport d'évaluation à mi-parcours de la SNDS 2023-2025
publisher: Direction Générale de la Statistique (DGS/DECSI), Ministère de la Planification et de la Prospective
